topics.title: GST Input Tax Credit (ITC) & GSTR-2B Automated Reconciliation
topics.objective: Reconcile vendor purchase registers against auto-populated GSTR-2B data to detect ineligible and blocked credits under Section 17(5).
topics.exercise: Write an automated matching algorithm matching vendor invoice numbers, GSTIN, and taxable value within a 1-rupee tolerance.

topics.title: Real-time E-Invoicing & E-Way Bill Generation
topics.objective: Generate Invoice Reference Numbers (IRN) via government IRP portals and embed signed QR codes on B2B invoices.
topics.exercise: Design an automated JSON payload generator and API dispatcher communicating with the GST e-invoice clearance portal.

topics.title: Transfer Pricing (TP) & Arm's Length Principle Documentation
topics.objective: Benchmark cross-border intercompany transactions using Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) and Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM).
topics.exercise: Compile a master file and local file transfer pricing audit documentation set establishing arm's length profit margins.

topics.title: TDS / TCS Withholding Tax Assessment & Form 26AS Audit
topics.objective: Calculate withholding tax rates under sections 194C, 194J, and 194Q and verify timely statutory deposit by the 7th of each month.
topics.exercise: Build a withholding tax compliance schedule tracking quarterly Form 24Q/26Q filings and TRACES certificate issuances.

topics.title: Corporate Tax Assessment & Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT)
topics.objective: Calculate standard corporate tax liability under Section 115BAA (22%) versus Section 115JB book profit Minimum Alternate Tax.
topics.exercise: Formulate a corporate tax computation worksheet adjusting book profit for statutory exempt incomes and depreciation differentials.
